def VTask.comk {α : Type u} (p : Set α → Prop) (he : p ∅) 
    (hmono : ∀ (t : Set α), p t → ∀ s ⊆ t, p s) 
    (hunion : ∀ (s : Set α), p s → ∀ (t : Set α), p t → p (s ∪ t)) : Filter α := 
  Filter.mk 
    (fun s => p sᶜ)
    he
    (fun s t hst hs => hmono sᶜ hs tᶜ (hst.compl_subset))
    (fun s t hs ht => hunion sᶜ hs tᶜ ht)
